Package smart_food_delivery.domain

Class ExpressOrder

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.domain.Order
smart_food_delivery.domain.ExpressOrder
public class ExpressOrder extends Order
Represents an express order in the Smart Food Delivery System. An express order includes an additional express delivery fee. This class extends the Order class and inherits its basic order information and behavior.

      Parameters:
      id - the unique order ID
      restaurant - the restaurant preparing the order
      items - the items included in the order
      deliveryAddress - the delivery address
      deliveryZone - the delivery zone
      expressFee - the additional express delivery fee
      Throws:
